metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities from Kodak E-26 (minor revision 4-97), KODAK VERICOLOR III Professional Film (5026, 6006), C-41, Status M. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its order at the dense end, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts. Mid-grey where a meter set to EI 160 puts it on the sheet's absolute axis (log H -1.294 lux-seconds). The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. The base density is the sheet's own D-min spectral density, base and fog, and the profile keeps its midscale neutral. The sheet plots no single-dye spectra: the dyes are those of the agx reference profile 'fujifilm_c200', of agx's colour negatives the best fit to the sheet's neutral over D-min, each moved and stretched about its peak until the three add up to it: cyan -1.1 nm x0.967, magenta +3.4 nm x1.086, yellow -3.1 nm x1.111. No spectral adaptation window: agx fits one to each of its own stocks' sensitivities. DIR coupler model from 'fujifilm_c200'.
